Bill.BriefDescription: Ensuring the rights of parents to monitor the communications and conversations of their minor children.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ensuring the rights of parents to monitor thecommunications and conversations of their minor children; amending RCW9.73.080; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that parents have theright and the responsibility to protect the welfare and health of theirminor children and that a parent therefore should not be criminallyliable for intercepting or recording any phone conversation of his orher minor child.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9.73.080 and 2000 c 195 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, any person, otherthan a parent or legal guardian who is monitoring his or her own minorchild's telephone conversations, who violates RCW 9.73.030 is guilty ofa gross misdemeanor. (2) Any person who knowingly alters, erases, or wrongfully p. 1 SHB 1178discloses any recording in violation of RCW 9.73.090(1)(c) is guilty ofa gross misdemeanor.
